title: Cloud Administrator
description:
**Experience:** 7–10 Years  
**Role:** Cloud Administrator

**Location- Bangalore, Coimbatore, Hyderabad**  
**Cloud Platforms:** Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Administrator with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure and AWS to manage, monitor, secure, and optimize cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in cloud operations, infrastructure administration, troubleshooting, automation, security, and cost optimization.

Key Responsibilities

* Administer and maintain Azure and AWS cloud infrastructure, including virtual machines, storage, networking, and cloud services.
* Monitor cloud environments for availability, performance, capacity, and security.
* Configure and manage Azure Virtual Networks, Virtual Machines, Azure Storage, Entra ID, and Azure Monitor.
* Manage AWS EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, and related services.
* Implement cloud security policies, identity and access management, role-based access control, and compliance practices.
* Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure, networking, connectivity, performance, and availability issues.
* Manage backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and high-availability configurations.
* Automate routine administration tasks using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or cloud-native automation tools.
* Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep.
* Optimize cloud resource utilization and costs through monitoring, rightsizing, and resource governance.
* Manage patching, upgrades, configuration changes, and infrastructure maintenance.
* Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and incident reports.
* Collaborate with DevOps, development, security, and IT operations teams to support business requirements.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* 7–10 years of experience in cloud administration, infrastructure management, or system administration.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and AWS cloud platforms.
* Good understanding of Windows Server and Linux administration.
* Strong knowledge of cloud networking, including VPC/VNet, subnets, routing, VPN, DNS, firewalls, and load balancers.
* Experience with IAM, access policies, encryption, security monitoring, and compliance.
* Experience with cloud monitoring, logging, alerting, incident management, and root-cause analysis.
* Knowledge of backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Scripting skills in PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Exposure to Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools.
* Experience with IT service management processes, including incident, problem, and change management.

Preferred Qualifications

* Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification.
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or AWS Solutions Architect certification.
* Experience managing hybrid cloud and multi-cloud environments.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containers, Kubernetes, and DevOps practices.

Key Competencies

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to manage critical infrastructure and resolve production incidents.
* Good communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate with cross-functional teams.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

**Department:** Front Office / Hospital Operations

**Location:** Chennai, Hosur, Trivandrum, Coimbatore, Tiruppur, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Noida

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **professional, energetic and detail-oriented Front Office Executive** to manage key reception, billing and hospital coordination responsibilities.

The role will involve working across **Reception and Billing**, generally on a rotational basis, based on hospital requirements. The ideal candidate should be comfortable interacting with pet parents, coordinating patient movement, maintaining records, handling billing transactions and supporting medicine stock management.

**What You'll Do**

**Reception & Hospital Coordination**

· Welcome walk-in pet parents and provide professional assistance throughout their visit.

· Understand the purpose of the visit and **guide clients to the assigned doctor or appropriate service area**.

· Register and manage **in-patients (IP)**, including patient details, admission records and required documentation.

· Coordinate and maintain records related to **boarding and kennel services**, including admissions, discharges and required documents.

· Maintain accurate registers and records for IP, boarding, kennel, procedures and other assigned hospital activities.

· Generate estimates based on approved services and coordinate with the relevant clinical teams to ensure applicable charges are captured.

· Ensure required forms, declarations, consent documents and other records are completed and maintained.

· Coordinate with doctors, assistants, billing, kennel/boarding and other hospital teams for smooth patient movement and service delivery.

· Complete clear shift handovers and communicate pending tasks, records or client-related matters.

**Billing & Medicine Stock**

· Generate accurate bills using the approved billing system and verify applicable services, procedures, medicines and other charges before billing.

· Handle cash, card, UPI and other approved payment modes accurately.

· Process approved discounts, returns, exchanges and billing adjustments as per company policy.

· Issue invoices and maintain required billing records.

· Reconcile billing transactions and cash at shift closure and report discrepancies promptly.

· Support **medicine stock management**, including monitoring stock levels, recording inward/outward movements and identifying low-stock or near-expiry items.

· Coordinate with the relevant team for stock replenishment and maintain accurate medicine-related records.

· Ensure billing and stock records are updated accurately and on time.

**What We're Looking For**

· **6 months – 2 years of experience** in front office, hospital reception, billing, pharmacy/medical store, customer service or a similar role.

· Good communication and interpersonal skills with a professional and courteous approach.

· Comfortable handling both **client-facing reception responsibilities and billing operations**.

· Basic knowledge of billing software, MS Office and computer operations.

· Good numerical accuracy, attention to detail and record-keeping skills.

· Ability to handle cash, digital payments and confidential patient information responsibly.

· Ability to maintain accurate registers, estimates, bills and stock records.

· Strong coordination and follow-up skills.

· Willingness to work in a **veterinary hospital environment and around pets and pet parents**.

· Ability to work flexibly across Reception and Billing based on hospital requirements.

**You Might Be a Great Fit If You Are**

· **Energetic, friendly and approachable**, with a natural ability to make clients feel comfortable.

· Organized and attentive to details, especially when handling records, billing and stock.

· Calm and professional while dealing with clients and busy hospital situations.

· Responsible and trustworthy when handling money, medicines and patient records.

· A proactive team player who can coordinate effectively with doctors and hospital teams.

· Willing to learn veterinary hospital processes and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

**Why Join SKS?**

Work in a growing veterinary healthcare organization and gain hands-on experience across **hospital reception, patient coordination, billing, boarding operations and medicine stock management**, while working closely with doctors and the wider hospital team.

title: Senior Demand Planner
description:
**The** **Opportunity:**
------------------------

Implements tactical and operational planning goals to optimize supply, demand, and inventory strategies for a defined portfolio. Contributes to the execution of new planning processes, product launches, or inventory optimization initiatives that impact service levels, cost efficiency, and overall departmental performance. Manages planning projects or processes, such as supply/demand balancing under constrained capacity, scenario planning, or safety stock optimization. Solves planning problems involving cross-functional variables such as forecast accuracy, lead times, asset utilization, and market fluctuations, often deriving solutions from limited data or historical precedents. Regularly communicates with internal teams across procurement, operations, finance, and commercial, and may coordinate directly with external vendors, contract manufacturers, or key customers. These communications often require translating data-driven insights into actionable plans while balancing risk, cost, and service objectives.

**Job Title: Sr Demand Planner**

**Location:** Coimbatore, India or Pune, India

**Scope of Role:** Global with specific regional and sub-business unit responsibilities assigned based on business need.
  
**Department:** Supply Chain / Demand Planning
  
**Reports To:** Senior Director of Demand Planning

**Position Summary**

The **Sr Demand Planner** role is responsible for the demand planning and S&OP process enablement for assigned market segments, sub-business units, or product categories. This role requires demonstrated success in structured problem solving and directly contributes to continuous improvement efforts by proactively identifying opportunities/risks, defining action plans, and execution efforts.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage planning systems to create forecasts and demand plans in support of the enterprise’s S&OP process

* Support and/or facilitate pre-Demand Review working sessions with S&OP stakeholders

* Define and record the assumptions included within the forecast and/or demand plan

* Perform trend analysis and solicit qualitative feedback from our commercial stakeholders to make informed adjustments to forecasts

* Perform ‘what if’ analysis to project outcomes for various business decisions and scenarios

* Track and measure plan performance, in example: forecast accuracy, forecast bias, forecast value add, and forecast attainment

* Prepare executive level summaries with clear and concise takeaways

* Present Demand Plans, risks & opportunities, and mitigation options to leadership

  

**Core Objectives**

* **Drive enterprise alignment:** Ensure consensus demand plans are documented and agreed to by S&OP leaders with decision rights

* **Enable Delivery Excellence:** Engage with cross functional stakeholders to ensure that the consensus plan is balancing demand with supply, capacity, and operational capability to ensure our internal and external operations teams can execute the consensus plan

* **Mitigate Financial Risk:** Continue to monitor plan performance and highlight gaps as they emerge to enable agile and aligned responses through the S&OP routines and in partnership with the S&OE teams

* **Apply Structured Problem-Solving**: leverage Lean methodologies (i.e. A3, PDCA, 5 Whys/Root Cause Analysis, DMAIC, etc) to identify and eliminate waste in our business processes and foster a culture of continuous improvement

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.

* APICS CPIM certification preferred

* Lean/Six Sigma certification preferred

* 5+ years of experience in supply chain, finance, or operations with a focus on working capital optimization.

* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in data/financial modeling

* Experience with supply chain finance programs and advanced planning tools like DA/Blue Yonder, Netstock, Aera, and Anaplan.

* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**ABOUT EIGENDYNE**

EigenDyne is a Tamil Nadu-based deep-tech robotics startup building adaptive, vision-driven robotic scanning systems for manufacturing and automotive OEM customers. Our platform combines classical computer vision, precision motion, and fleet-level software to automate inspection and quality workflows on the factory floor. We are recognized under the Startup India (Deep Tech) initiative.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for an experienced Robotics Engineer to design, develop, and deploy robotic arm-based automation solutions. You will own the ROS2 software stack for our robotic arm platforms, from simulation in Gazebo through to real-world deployment on the shop floor with industrial customers. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role suited to an engineer who enjoys working across the full stack — motion planning, integration, and field deployment.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, and maintain ROS2-based software for robotic arm (cobot) platforms used in variousapplications
* Build and validate simulation environments in Gazebo for motion planning, path validation, and workcell layout before physical deployment
* Integrate robotic arms with vision sensors, end-effectors, and scanning payloads
* Develop and tune motion planning (e.g., MoveIt2)
